metadata.note: High-resolution expansion; universal sensor-enabled shelves; SKU-specific stationary demand models with area-specific scaling; consumables-only.

demand_profiles.intraday_rule: Allocate daily demand into time windows using SKU intraday_profile weights (sum=1.0).
demand_profiles.notes: Consumption is applied at point-of-use areas only; stockrooms/satellite/central act as buffers via par policies and replenishment tasks.

operations_model.notes: Travel times stochastic via edges_detailed travel_time_model. Consumption stochastic via SKU consumption_model. Replenishment uses shelf_bins par/reorder/max for each area-sku pair.
